batting.name: AC Gilchrist
batting.dismissal: c M Rawat b SK Trivedi

batting.name: HH Gibbs
batting.dismissal: c M Rawat b MM Patel

batting.name: SB Styris
batting.dismissal: c SK Warne b YK Pathan

batting.name: Shahid Afridi
batting.dismissal: c MM Patel b SK Warne

batting.name: SB Bangar
batting.dismissal: c M Rawat b SR Watson

batting.name: GC Smith
batting.dismissal: c PP Ojha b RP Singh

batting.name: YK Pathan
batting.dismissal: c HH Gibbs b PP Ojha

balls.text: Tanvir ends the innings with a full slower ball on middle and leg, Ohja gets beaten and is hit on the pad, they run  leg bye
Venugopal moves across his stumps and tries to paddle the ball down to fine leg, he gets hit on the pad for a leg bye towards square leg
a full ball angles into off stump, Ojha pushes at it and gets an outside edge towards the keeper, that nearly got past Rawat who dived to his left to collect
cut hard towards point for the single
Venugopal clears his front foot out of the way and smashes Tanvir over wide long on for six!

the slower ball bowled full outside off stump, RP misses the slog and tries to steal the bye to give Venugopal the strike, Rawat misses the underarm throw at the striker's end but Tanvir collects and throws down the stumps at the bowler's end to run out RP
Tanvir sprays the first ball of the last over down leg side, wide called
RP comes down the track and lofts Warne on the first bounce to long on, that's the end of Warne's spell, 4-0-19-2, fantastic effort
Venugopal tries to loft down the ground and gets an inside edge towards square leg
pushed towards the leg side for one
now Teja's attempted the reverse sweep against Warne and he's lbw! He premeditated the shot and got hit on the pad in front of leg and middle, that did pitch outside leg stump though
Venugopal comes down the track, gets beaten by the flight and then doesn't know what to do, the ball went straight on and hit the back leg
shot! Venugopal Rao gets down on one knee and slog sweeps Warne against the turn to the deep square leg boundary, impressive!
a good length ball angles into the right-hander, defended on the front foot back towards the bowler
that ball skidded into the right-hander from outside of stump, Teja wanted to cut it but was cramped for room and beaten
a good length ball angles into the right-hander, Venugopal moves forward and pushes the ball towards point for one more
too full outside off stump, there's a bit of width as well and Venugopal slashes and places the ball behind point for another four
Venugopal flicks a full toss through midwicket, yusuf dives full length but can't save it, well placed by Venugopal
the slower ball angles into Teja's block hole from round the wicket, pushed off the front foot on the off side
excellent short ball outside off stump, Venugopal tries to cut behind point but gets beaten by the high bounce
short of a length outside off stump, Teja moves towards the ball and cuts towards deep point for one, Teja's an opening batsman mind you
the length is a bit short outside off stump, Teja moves towards the off side and pulls the ball firmly between midwicket and mid-on for four
short of a length outside off stump, Venugopal cuts it towards third man

caught! Watson bangs in a sharp short ball that angles into the right-hander, cramping him for room, Bangar gets surprised by the pace and bounce and jumps on to the back foot, he tries to open the face and run the ball to third man but only manages to edge to the wicketkeeper
Watson slips one down leg side, Bangar misses the leg glance and the ball brushes the pad on its way through to Rawat
Teja moves back and across and defends towards the off side
defended on the front foot towards the off side

loud shout for lbw and then there is a run out! Sharma tried to flick another ball from the blockhole and got hit on the pad, Trivedi appealed for leg before but umpire Benson said not out, the ball had gone towards cover off the pad and Sharma wanted the leg bye, he was sent back and Warne threw down the stumps from cover before he could regain his ground at the striker's end, Deccan are struggling now
the slower ball angled into the blockhole, Sharma had backed away, looking to hit over extra cover but had to dig it out in the end
short of a length outside off stump, Bangar waits on the back foot and runs the ball to third man
full ball on the pads, Sharma flicks off his pads towards long leg
loud appeal for lbw, Bangar pushed forward and Warne hit him on the pad with what looked like a leg break, Saheba says not out, Bangar was a long way forward
Bangar leans forward and pushes the ball towards wide long on for two
Warne pitches the ball on middle and off and rips the leg break across the batsman's front foot defence, magnificent bowling
defended on the front foot to the leg side

caught!! Afridi charged out of his crease and tried to blast the ball down the ground, he was no where close to the pitch of the ball and once Warne began to turn it away from him he had no chance, he threw his bat wildly at it and got a top edge that went towards backward point where Munaf held the catch over his head
tossed up on middle stump, Afridi moves across and tries to slog sweep but the ball spins across him and hits him on the body
excellent shot, Sharma makes room by moving towards leg and lofts the ball inside out over extra cover, an equally excellent effort on the boundary saves a couple of runs
the slower ball bowled on a good length on off and middle, Sharma closes the face and plays the ball to midwicket
Afridi moves out of his crease and defends a short of a length delivery towards the leg side and continues running the quick single

Trivedi's got a huge wicket! He bowled a full and wide ball outside off stump, Gilchrist chased it, trying to drive through cover, even though it was a bit too wide and got a thin edge through to Rawat, he's gone for 61, massive blow for Deccan
Gilchrist steps out of his crease and tries to pull but he gets beaten by a slower short ball from Trivedi, clever change of pace
Trivedi strays on to middle and leg, Sharma misses the leg glance but gets hit on the thigh for  a leg bye to fine leg
that is a flat hit! Gilchrist plants his front foot forward and slogs Yusuf flat over midwicket, the ball bounces just inside the boudnary before going over
Yusuf spears the ball into middle and leg, Gilchrist moves back and plays the ball off his pads through square leg
Rohit gets behind the line and closes the face of the bat to play the ball through square leg
Gilchrist plays the ball through cover point off the front foot

caught! Warne holds on to a skier! Styris tried to loft Yusuf over midwicket once again, his time he tried to drag it from outside off and got a top edge, the ball went extremely high in the air but got no further than Warne at midwicket, well-judged catch
bowled full and flat, Gilchrist drives towards long on for one
excellent ball, in the block hole, Styris came forward and dug it out towards the bowler
driven  firmly off the front foot through cover for one
dropped, Gilchrist smashed a full ball right back at Trivedi who stuck his hands out to his left but couldn't hold on, he got both hands to it but Gilchrist had just hit it too hard, tough chance
fuller length on middle and off, Gilchrist moves forward and pulls the ball towards midwicket
short length and Styris goes back and pulls the ball towards deep square leg
he starts off with a slower one on middle stump, Gilchrist tries to hit it into the stands at midwicket but mis-times it behind square
nudged off his pads on the front foot towards midwicket
Gilchrist tries to pull a flat ball from outside off but gets beaten
full and flat delivery, driven down the ground for one
Styris goes airborne! He stepped out of his crease, didn't get to the pitch of the ball but he swung his bat hard and smashed the ball on to the roof at deep midwicket
Gilchrist gets to his second successive half-century but nudging a flat delivery off his pads through midwicket, well played!
Styris leans forward and pushes the ball towards midwicket, he calls for a risky single but Warne couldn't throw the ball quickly enough to Pathan
full and wide outside off stump, Gilchrist tries to drive through point but gets beaten, Munaf is done with his spell, 1 for 29 off his four overs
Styris moves forward once again and immediately calls for the single once he drives towards mid-on
full delivery outside off stump, Gilchrist drives powerfully off the front foot through cover
a full toss outside off stump, Gilchrist moves forward, frees his arms, and cuts the ball hard in the air through point, he's on 48 with that four
Styris moves forward to a good length ball on off stump and drives towards mid-off and calls for a quick single
full ball outside of stump, Gilchrist drives the ball behind point for  a single
defended back towards the bowler
bowled flat through the air on off stump, Gilchrist moves back and drives towards long off
flighted delivery on off stump, the ball spins away from Styris who leans forward and plays the ball behind point
tossed up across the left-hander from over the wicket, Gilchrist moves forward and swats the ball to deep midwicket from outside off
fuller length on off stump, Styris moves forward, gets to the pitch of the ball and drives through cover
Gilchrist leans forward and drives towards long on for one

caught! Munaf comes back and how! He pitched the ball just short of a length around off stump and seamed it away from the right-hander, Gibbs stayed in his crease and poked at it, Rawat took the thin edge with ease, no footwork from Gibbs on that occasion
lovely placement, Gibbs moved forward to the half-volley outside off stump and drove the ball through extra cover, once it beat the in-field no one could stop it
the slower ball on leg stump, Gilchrist moves forward and hits the ball on the first bounce to Watson at fine leg
full length outside the off stump from Munaf, Gibbs strides forward and drives towards deep cover for one more
driven off the front foot through cover for  a single

good length delivery on off stump, Gilchrist pushes the ball towards mid-off and begins to start off for the single, munaf runs across to field and Giclhrist goes back, Munaf throws the ball at the batsman's end and hits Gilchrist, unintentionally of course
Gibbs moves his front foot a long way across his stumps and sweeps towards long leg, he will get two for it, end of an exciting over from Warne
bowled straight, flat and fast, Gilchrist moves back and pushes the ball towards long-on for  a single
bowled full on leg stump, Gibbs tries to sweep but mis-times it to short fine leg
another big leg break draws Gibbs forward and spins past the outside edge of his bat
defended towards cover on the front foot

big turn first up and there's an appeal for a stumping, Warne pitched the leg break  on a good length, drew Gibbs forward, and ripped it across the outside edge of  his front-foot defence, Rawat whipped off the bails, Gibb's back foot was in the air for a fraction of a second but it's too close to call, the third umpire says not out
that is too full and just a bit wide outside off, Gilchrist bends down and dispatches the ball through cover point with a hard square drive
fuller ball on off stump, Gilchrist drives towards mid-off on the front foot
good length from Munaf just outside off, Gilchrist doesn't have room to cut

that's streaky! Gilchrist tries to smash a fuller ball from outside off stump through the leg side, he gets a thick outside edge that flies between the keeper and Warne at a wide first slip and runs to the third man boundary
Gilchrist plants his foot forward and tries to drive a good length ball through cover, he can't beat the fielder at short cover
bowled on a good length on off stump, Gibbs pushed the ball off the front foot towards cover and called for the single
140 kmh on a good length on off and middle, Gibbs strides forward to defend and gets an inside edge on the leg side
too full and wide outside off stump, Gibbs reaches out for it and lofts the ball in the air but over the fielder at mid-off, that is his first boundary, uppish but safe
good length on off and middle, Gilchrist defends on the back foot towards the leg side

that's disappeared! Gilchrist moves his front foot forward, picks the ball off and length and swings the bat hard to send it soaring over deep square leg, massive hit, the line was a bit too straight from Watson, allowing Gilchrist to hit with the angle into him
Watson hits a good length outside off from round the wicket, cramping the left-hander for room with the angle into the batsman, Gilchrist defends on the front foot
Gilchrist tries to cut a short of a length ball outside off but bottom edges it

dropped, Smith's grassed a sitter, Gibbs waited on the back foot and lofted a short and wide ball straight to Smith at cover,he seemed to have caught it but the ball popped out, it was a flat catch and a dolly as well

Gibbs moves his front foot across his stumps to paddle a good length ball from outside off towards long leg, Gibbs sees that the fielder on the boundary is rather square and he calls Gilchrist back for the second
good length delivery on off stump, Gibbs comes forward and defends towards cover
that is just short of a length but Gilchrist moves back so quickly that he has enough time to pull towards deep square leg
once again the length isn't short enough to pull, the ball hurries on to Gibbs who gets a bottom edge behind square for a single
Gibbs tries to pull from outside off but the length isn't short enough and he gets beaten
short of a length outside off stump, Gilchrist gets behind the line on the back foot and defends towards cover point
too straight this time, on leg stump, Gilchrist leans across and nudges the slower ball off his pads towards the fine leg boundary
too full too wide and someone will have to fetch that, Gilchrist reached out for the ball on the front foot and drove it powerfully through cover with a full swing of his bat

massive shout for lbw, Gilchrist gets his front foot across and tries to pull a short of a length ball across the line, he misses and Tanvir hits him on the pad with the ball that swings into the left-hander, that was missing leg stump
defended on the front foot towards the leg side

smashed! Gilchrist moved forward to a full ball and drives it in the air but just wide of the fielder at mid-off, it was Jadeja in that position and he had no chance for the ball was struck with immense power
Gilchrist leans forward to drive a good length ball and mis-times it past the bowler, he sets off for the quick single, just five off Watson's over, good stuff
the line is a bit straight this time, on middle and leg, Gibbs moves his front foot across and works the ball off his pads behind square for a single
good length from Watson outside off, Gibbs strides forward and defends towards point

the length is a fraction short and the line is angling into the left-hander from round the wicket, Gilchrist tries to pull but is into the shot too early and gets an inside edge on to his thigh, it was a slower ball
he over-steps while bowling a good length ball which Gilchrist drives back to the bowler, free hit coming up, only one free hit has been hit for six so far in the competition
tight line and length angling into off stump, Gibbs pushes towards cover on the front foot and sets off for the single
pitches on a good length outside off stump and nips back into the right-hander, Gibbs moves forward and lets it go through to Rawat
width offered outside off stump and the length is short enough for Gilchrist to free his arms and cut the ball in the air over Kaif at point, the over began and ended with a four, eight off it
a good length delivery pitches outside off and seams away from Gilchrist who moves forward and opens the face to drive the ball towards point where Kaif dives to his left and fields
short of a length and wide outside off stump, this one seams away from the left-hander instead of swinging in, Gilchrist lets it go
good length from Tanvir on off stump, Gilchrist moves back in his crease and defends towards cover
fuller length and the line is closer to off stump, swinging into the left-hander, Gilchrist moves across and plays it towards midwicket
cracking start! The ball was too full and wide outside off stump, it swung in a bit to Gilchrist who moved forward, reached out for the ball and drove it fiercely through cover
Watson finishes the game, he moves forward to a good length ball and hits RP through the line straight down the ground past the fielder at mid-off
Kaif steps out of his crease and flicks a low full toss to deep midwicket, Sharma pulls it in just inside the boundary
short of a length ball angles across Watson who pulls off the front foot through midwicket to get going
Smith's holes out! He backs away towards the leg side and tries to go over mid-on, he doesn't get the elevation and hits it straight to Ojha who takes an easy catch, too little too late for Deccan
this time Smith tries to make room and RP follows him with the yorker that beats the drive and just misses leg stump
Smith backs away towards the leg side and powerfully drives a fuller ball straight back past the bowler for four more, only eight needed now
defended solidly off the front foot towards the off side
pushed off the front foot towards point, he's played it with soft hands and they run quickly for two
Ojha fires the ball down leg side, Kaif can't connect with the sweep and Gilchrist can't collect it either, five wides
and once again he follows up by stepping out of the crease and lofting the ball cleanly over mid-on for four more
once again Kaif gets beaten on the forward defence
Kaif plants his front foot forward and lofts Ojha over extra cover, he clears the infield and the ball runs to the boundary, Gibbs was in the circle at mid-off
bowled flat through the air outside off stump, Kaif pushes forward and tries to defend but the ball spins across his outside edge
Kaif leans forward to a fuller ball outside off stump and punches through extra cover for  a single, he will keep the strike
good length on off stump, Kaif waits on the back foot and opens the face of the bat to play the ball towards point
tight line and length from RP on off stump, Kaif defends back towards RP who runs to field the ball and kicks it on to the stumps
good length delivery on off stump, defended on the front foot towards point
a full ball angles into the right-hander from round the wicket, Kaif leans forward and drives in the air but in front of the fielder at point for  two more
good length delivery slanting across the right-hander from over the wicket, Kaif lets it go
Kaif gets off the mark by moving back in his crease and flicking the ball towards square leg
Smith leans forward and tries to flick a delivery from outside off, he misses and gets hit on the pad outside the line of off stump

caught! Yusuf charges down the pitch, Ojha bowls it slightly short outside off stump, Yusuf flat-bats it towards long-off where Gibbs holds on to a catch that was travelling flat and fast towards him, Yusuf leaves the field after causing severe damage to Deccan
bowled flat and fast down leg side, another wide
driven firmly off the back foot through cover, the batsmen run quickly and come back for  a second
bowled flat down leg side from over the wicket, Yusuf sweeps and places it wide of the fielder at short fine leg, four more and this match will be over in a jiffy
Smith backs away towards leg and drives the ball towards cover
Yusuf backs away to make room and powers the drive through extra cover, he's split the gap and will get four more

Smith moves a long way towards leg side to make room, Venugopal bowls a fuller one which Smith drives to midwicket, RP misses the direct hit at the bowler's end or else Yusuf would have been out, then the batsmen run over throws
now he gets down on one knee and sweeps firmly to deep backward square leg
Yusuf charges down the pitch, Venugopal bowls it short but Yusuf has enough time to get into position and pull the ball hard to the wide long-on boundary
driven towards long-on off the front foot for a single

Smith moves back and drives the ball through midwicket, he runs the first one quickly and then comes back for the second, the throw comes back at the bowler's end and Venugopal breaks the stumps, Yusuf was just home, he grounded his bat expertly and used his long reach to good effect
he bowls it wide down leg side, Gilchrist can't collect cleanly and they run a single
Yusuf comes down the track and pulls the ball powerfully to deep midwicket, he will keep the strike
Yusuf clears his front foot out of the way and tries to slog a full ball over deep midwicket, he gets an inside edge on to the pad
Smith moves forward and outside the line of off stump to work the ball towards midwicket for a single
fuller ball on middle stump, Smith works it off his pads towards square leg
once again Yusuf clubs the ball with a straight bat to long-on

he drops the ball short and Yusuf rocks back and smashes the ball past the bowler with a straight bat, Afridi slides on the boudnary and saves the four, Yusuf reaches 50 off 28 balls, he's taken the game away from Deccan
a low full toss and Yusuf leans forward and clips it off his pads towards the fielder at wide long-on
Yusuf backs away to make room and tries to smash a good length ball down the ground, the ball hits the inside edge of his mighty swing and runs towards the fine leg boundary, he's riding his luck
Yusuf tries to pull a ball that bounces a touch more and mis-hits it, the ball falls short of Styris who is at midwicket
and again! Yusuf moves forward to a full ball and clubs the ball towards long-on, gibbs runs to his right on the boundary and taps the ball inside the field of play

that is a fraction short and Yusuf picks the gap to perfection, he plants his front foot forward and pulls the ball into the gap between deep midwicket and long-on for four, he's hit it with such power
good length ball on leg stump, Smith backs away towards leg to make room, Bangar follows him and Smith drives to long-on for one
bowled full on middle stump, smith drives off the front foot to long on and runs the single
Smith moves across his stumps and gets down on one knee, trying to sweep, he gets beaten
this time he moves back and cuts the ball hard towards point
Smith chips the ball in the air behidn square on the leg side for a single, he tried to sweep but got a top edge
Smith tries to cut a flat and fast ball from outside of and gets beaten
Yusuf gets down on one knee and sweeps the ball in front off square for a single
the slower ball on a good length on middle stump, Yusuf plays off the back foot towards mid-on for  a single
Smith tries to flick the ball off his pads but gets a leading edge towards mid-off for  a single
too straight from Bangar on middle and leg, Yusuf stays in his crease and whips the ball off his pads towards deep backward square leg
he steps down the track once again and Bangar bowls another short ball, this time the line is down leg side and Yusuf pulls and gets a bit of glove on it to send the ball to the fine leg boundary
Yusuf takes two steps down the pitch at Bangar and tries to pull an excellent short ball, he gets beaten
good length on middle and off stump, Smith gets behind the line and drives towards long off for a single
Smith moves forward and pushes the ball towards point for a single to end the over
Smith gets down on one knee and sweeps the ball powerfully into the gap at deep square leg
defended back to the bowler
Yusuf tries to slog Afridi over midwicket and skies an extremely high catch, no one calls for it and Vijay Kumar can't reach the ball in time, poor effort
Smith tries to defend the ball towards the off side, that kept low, Yusuf calls him through for one
Smith tries to cut but gets beaten but a quicker one outside off

Yusuf charges once again and slices the ball inside out over cover, the ball is running towards the boundary but Sharma slides and pulls the ball in, however his foot was touching the rope as he pulled it in so that is another four, Rajasthan reach their 50
now he steps out of his crease and drives the ball hard and past the fielder at mid-on, four this time
that is hit very flat but the ball clears the midwicket boudnary, Yusuf gets down on one knee and slog sweeps cleanly, powerful hit
driven off the front foot towards long on for a single
Yusuf tries to loft over the straight boundary but doesn't time it well, he's placed it very straight though so the ball falls safely
pitches on leg stump first up, Smith moves across his stumps and flicks off his pads behind square
Smith backs away towards leg again but Styris follows him with a full ball, Smith pushes it towards midwicket for one
defended back to the bowler on the front foot
Smith backs away towards the leg side to make room even before Styris releases the ball, he reaches out for the ball and drives through extra cover
pushed on the back foot towards mid-on
Smith nudges the ball off the back foot towards backward point and calls for the quick single
good length delivery outside off stump, Smith moves back and works the ball towards square leg

too full outside off stump, angling into the right-hander, Yusuf strides forward and slams the off drive towards mid-off's left, the fielder can't dive quickly enough and the ball screams to the boundary, powerful hit, RP is annoyed with himself and kicks the ground
a short of a length ball pitches outside off stump and slants across the right-hander, Yusuf tries to reach for it but can't, the umpire calls it wide
Smith moves forward and flicks the ball off his pads towards midwicket for a single
good length from RP, on off and middle stump, Smith gets behind the line on the front foot and defends solidly
Yusuf tries to blast the ball through the off side off the back foot but mis-times it into the ground towards cover point
fuller ball outside off stump, Smith moves forward and pushes firmly towards cover point for a quick single. a fumble from Styris allows it
Smith uses the angle into him from over the wicket to move forward and push the ball towards midwicket
Yusuf strides forward and tries to run the ball towards third man with an open face but gets beaten

he's launched that into orbit! Yusuf merely plants his front foot forward and slogs the ball high over deep midwicket, the ball falls on the roof and they may have to call for a new one, first six of the innings
Smith moves back and nudges a good length ball that angles into him towards square leg for the single
good length from Styris on off stump, Yusuf moves forward and pushes towards cover point and sets off for the single, Teja hits the stumps direct at the bowler's end but Yusuf is safe
Yusuf moves forward and drives uppishly towards cover

Styris pitches the ball on middle and angles it down leg side, Yusuf tries to play the paddle sweep by moving across his stumps but misses, he loses balance and Gilchrist whips off the bails, Yusuf's back leg was just behind the crease, wide called by the way
tight line and length on off and middle stump, Yusuf defends on the front foot back to the bowler
Smith walks out of his crease and tries to work the ball on the leg side, he gets squared up by a short of a length delivery that seams away from him and the outside edge falls well short of slip
fuller ball outside off stump, Smith strides forward and punches the ball towards cover
defended on the front foot towards the off side, tight line and length from RP
good length delivery once again on middle stump, RP is getting the ball to straighten into the right-hander, Yusuf defends back to the bowler off the front foot

loud appeal for lbw, a full ball swings into the right-hander after angling across him, Yusuf tries to flick across the line and gets hit on the pad, that might have missed leg, replays show the ball clipping leg
good length delivery slanting across the right-hander's off stump, Yusuf tries to drive off the back foot but mis-times it to cover
once again he pitches on middle and leg, Yusuf moves forward and across and flicks off his pads towards fine leg
that isn't short enough to pull and smith mis-times the shot to midwicket where a fumble allows the single
Smith moves forward and across his stumps to flick a ball from outside off towards square leg
good length delivery outside off stump, Smith moves back in his crease and defends towards the off side
he does it again, Vijaykumar pitches on leg stump and allows Smith to shuffle towards the off side and nudge the ball off his hips past Gilchrist for four more
poor line first line, on leg stump, Smith moves across his stumps and plays the leg glance to the fine-leg boundary, Smith begins the innings with a four, just like Gilchrist did
